verdict.rationale: Airweave is API-first. It publishes an OpenAPI spec and an SDK that creates source connections and collections. Search, direct token injection and webhooks are all exposed programmatically, and a community user describes it as 'Agentspace but without the UI', which supports the API-first reading. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or feature matrix confirming API/UI parity, evidence that admin features like org settings, members and billing are API-accessible, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
